description: Defines the Camera3BufferManager class responsible for managing graphics buffers used by camera output streams in Android. It handles buffer registration, allocation, deallocation, and tracking for multiple streams and stream sets, including buffer sharing and memory footprint optimization.

classes.name: Camera3BufferManager
classes.description: Manages graphic buffers for camera output streams, including registration, buffer acquisition, release, and removal, with support for multiple stream sets and buffer sharing.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers an output stream with the buffer manager, providing stream info for buffer allocation.

methods.name: unregisterStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream, freeing associated buffers if no longer in use.

methods.name: getBufferForStream
methods.description: Obtains a buffer for a specified stream, either from free buffers or by allocating new ones.

methods.name: onBufferReleased
methods.description: Notifies the buffer manager that a buffer has been released by the consumer.

methods.name: onBuffersRemoved
methods.description: Updates internal state when buffers are removed from the queue.

methods.name: notifyBufferRemoved
methods.description: Informs the manager that buffers have been freed from the queue.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal statistics and state information for debugging.
